verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a CRM, since some CRMs offer self-hosted deployments, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents running Sales Cloud on your own infrastructure. The CLI, scratch orgs and local Lightning Web Component development are developer tooling that works against Salesforce-hosted orgs, not a self-hosted core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
